independent_tests.test_output_summary: Independent test verification skipped (tests not required for testing tasks)

criteria_results.evidence: Added make_memory_episode factory function to tests/conftest.py (lines 248-265). The factory returns MemoryEpisodeV1 with sensible defaults and accepts **overrides including body= for creating oversized episodes to test MAX_EPISODE_BODY_BYTES boundary conditions.

Existing tests in test_memory_episode.py already cover all requirements: test_memory_episode_required_fields (required fields), test_memory_episode_optional_fields (optional fields), test_no_group_id_field (group_id absent), test_extra_fields_ignored_forward_compat and test_model_validate_json_with_extra_fields (extra="ignore"), test_episode_type_nats_safe_identifier_invalid (episode_type validation). Added @pytest.mark.unit, @pytest.mark.smoke, and @pytest.mark.negative markers as specified.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Happy-path `publish_episode` test asserts the single `mock_nc.publish` call's
criteria_results.evidence: test_publish_episode_publishes_raw_json_with_nats_msg_id_header in test_client.py verifies: (1) mock_nc.publish called exactly once, (2) subject resolves to 'memory.episode.finproxy.feature_outcome', (3) body is raw MemoryEpisodeV1 JSON (re-parseable, not envelope-wrapped), (4) headers['Nats-Msg-Id'] == 'e1'. Added @pytest.mark.smoke marker.

criteria_results.criterion_text: Oversized-body test asserts `ValueError` (with measured size + limit in the message)
criteria_results.evidence: test_publish_episode_rejects_oversized_episode verifies: (1) creates episode exceeding MAX_EPISODE_BODY_BYTES, (2) raises ValueError with size and limit in message, (3) mock_nc.publish not called. test_publish_episode_accepts_episode_at_size_limit verifies under-limit episode publishes once. Added @pytest.mark.boundary and @pytest.mark.negative markers.

test_publish_episode_raises_runtime_error_when_not_connected verifies that calling publish_episode on a fresh (un-connected) NATSClient raises RuntimeError with match='client is not connected'. Added @pytest.mark.negative marker.
